method.note: The control and candidate were run as fresh Chrome processes against the same local fixture. Browser cache and shader-cache state can affect absolute startup time; treat this as a bounded compatibility/performance probe, not a cross-machine guarantee.

comparison.reason: All three candidate sessions created concurrently and preserved the exact 91-token transcript. Keep the flag opt-in: a mixed WebGPU/WASM attempt reproduced ORT's multiple calls to initWasm() failure, and earlier WebGPU runs reported concurrent EP creation errors. No public default change is justified without another browser/adapter and lifecycle soak.
